correctness.rationale: Over F2, the adjacency Laurent polynomial becomes x^b Gamma(x)=(1+x^{b-a})(1+x^{a+b}), so nullity equals degree gcd(x^n-1, product). Factoring n=2^t m and tracking repeated-root multiplicities proves exact kappa formula with odd-part gcds and 2-adic valuations. Coprimality and proper-divisor case analysis give kappa<=n/2+1 for n=2 mod4, <=n/2+2 otherwise; the constructed steps a=1,b=n/2-1 attain each bound. The independent GF2 row-reduction checked all 1752 admissible connected (n,a,b) triples at even n<=32, including minimum at each n. Finite checks corroborate the arbitrary-even-n proof.
